context: A mom teaches her young son table manners at lunch
purpose: Teach: 丼/宴会/唇/食物/爪/昨晩/汚い/症候群

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、ちょっと待って。ご飯食べる前に爪を見せて。
lines.en: Sho, wait a moment. Show me your nails before you eat.
lines.style: Gentle but firm motherly tone, slightly raised eyebrow with a patient smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー、昨晩お風呂入ったよ?きれいだもん。
lines.en: What? I took a bath last night. They're clean!
lines.style: Whiny child voice, slightly pouting and defensive in tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほら、汚いでしょ。爪の間に泥が入ってる。手を洗ってきなさい。
lines.en: See, they're dirty. There's mud under the nails. Go wash your hands.
lines.style: Calm correcting voice, pointing softly with a sigh of mild exasperation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はーい…ねえ、今日のお昼は何?牛丼?
lines.en: Okay... Hey, what's for lunch today? Beef bowl?
lines.style: Reluctant agreement followed by curious excited child question.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ううん、親子丼よ。でも口を開けたまま噛まないでね。唇を閉じて食べるのよ。
lines.en: No, it's oyakodon. But don't chew with your mouth open. Eat with your lips closed.
lines.style: Warm instructive tone, miming the action softly with her own mouth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパは宴会だとくちゃくちゃ食べてるよ?昨日テレビで見た『くちゃくちゃ症候群』かもね!
lines.en: But Dad eats noisily at banquets, you know? Maybe he has that 'noisy-chewing syndrome' I saw on TV!
lines.style: Innocent tattling voice with a mischievous giggle, proud of repeating a TV phrase.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、パパの真似はしないの。それに卵は食物アレルギーの子もいるから、よく噛んで感謝して食べようね。
lines.en: Haha, don't imitate Dad. Also, some kids have egg food allergies, so chew well and eat with gratitude.
lines.style: Patient teaching voice, lowering slightly to convey seriousness and warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はーい!唇を閉じて、ゆっくり食べる。いただきます!
lines.en: Okaaay! Lips closed, eat slowly. Itadakimasu!
lines.style: Bright cheerful child voice, sitting up straight with hands pressed together happily.
